 Print Gift exchanges reach their peak for Libra on this Diwali Sunday. Your own sign hosts a full gathering tonight: the Sun, the new Moon, retrograde Mercury and Venus, your ruling planet, also retrograde. With so much energy in your first house, people look to you as the host, the giver, and the family's face. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your sixth, is your yogakaraka. It reminds you that a gift's value lies in the thought behind it. Amavasya in Your Sign
 The new Moon in Libra marks a fresh start for you. Whatever you give or receive tonight carries symbolic weight for the year ahead. A gift chosen with someone’s real needs in mind sets a good tone. Watch Shani Is Coming for You : Are You Entering Shani’s Most Dangerous Phase | Ft. Acharya Vikramaditya Retrograde Venus favours personal touches. A handwritten card, a photo frame of an old family moment or a homemade sweet can touch hearts more deeply than anything bought in haste. When Receiving Gifts
 Venus in reverse can also stir mixed feelings about gifts you receive. Someone may give less than you expected, or more than you can repay. Accept everything graciously. Comparing gifts tonight only spoils the festival. Mercury’s retrograde may also cause mix-ups, such as tags falling off or a gift reaching the wrong person. Label boxes clearly. Shani Values Effort Over Cost
 Shani in your sixth rules your fourth and fifth houses, linking it to home and children. It notices time and effort. An hour spent with a lonely relative or helping a child finish a rangoli counts as a gift too. Shani’s glance on Virgo, your twelfth, warns against overspending to cover feelings of guilt. Give what feels sincere, not what feels like penance. Jupiter in the Eleventh
 Jupiter and Ketu in Leo, your eleventh, bless friendships. A friend’s simple gesture may move you tonight. Return the warmth with words, not price tags. Do’s for Today
 Add a handwritten note to every gift.
 Label gift boxes clearly.
 Spend time with a relative who is alone.
 Don’ts for Today
 Do not compare gifts received.
 Avoid regifting items without care.
 Skip buying last-minute expensive gifts.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Make a simple handmade card or diya for an elder in your family. Gift a new set of clothes to the child of a domestic worker.
